svg.title: rails/rails
svg.desc: Star history for rails/rails over 3 months. 2,048 current stars. 234 recorded additions in range. 2026-06-14 to 2026-09-06. Scale: absolute. Display intervals subdivide nominal API weeks; the final week may still be partial. Column height approximates cumulative recorded stars in whole tiles; shading marks distance below each column tip, not value ranges.
